story.p1: {{full}} yi sungule hi nkarhi wa ku tinyungubyisa. {{founder}} u vone munghana wa yena wa le kusuhi a sungula khampani ya yena, leyi tirhaka ngopfu hi vukorhokeri bya ku xavisa, kutani a tivonela leswaku ku laveka xivindzi xo tanihi kwihi ku sungula.
story.p2: Nkarhi wolowo wu tshame na yena. Khale a tsakela ku pfuna ti-SMME ku fikelela swikongomelo swa tona, ku hluvuka ni ku kula, naswona a a lava ku aka nchumu lowu nga ta yima na tona loko ti endla sweswo.
story.p3: Vito i rungula leri a a lava ku ri rhumela eka munghana wa yena, ni le ka mabindzu ni minhlangano hinkwayo leyi yi tirhisaka: ma swi kota. Yisani emahlweni mi tikarhata, mi nga tshuki mi yima.

smsSteps.account: Pfula akhawunti eka BulkSMS, Clickatell kumbe Twilio kutani u xava krediti.
smsSteps.keys: Endla swilotlelo swa API eka dexibodo ya muphakeri kutani u swi namarhela laha hansi.

webhookHelp.sms: Eka dexibodo ya muphakeri wa wena wa SMS, veka leswi tani hi adirese ya marungula lama nghenaka (inbound / reply webhook) leswaku tinhlamulo ti fika eka YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Hlanganisa nomboro ya wena ya WhatsApp Business hi Cloud API ya ximfumo ya Meta. Marungula ma huma eka nomboro ya wena naswona tinhlamulo ti nghena eka Marungula.

whatsappSteps.app: Ya eka developers.facebook.com, endla app ya muxaka wa Business kutani u engetela xiendliwa xa WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ehansi ka WhatsApp > API Setup, engetela nomboro ya riqingho ya bindzu ra wena kutani u kopa Phone number ID ni WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Swi namarhele laha hansi, funga "Tirhisa WhatsApp", hlayisa, kutani u ringeta hi nomboro ya wena ya selifoni.
whatsappSteps.token: Eka Business Settings > System users, endla access token ya hilaha ku nga heriki leyi nga ni mpfumelelo wa whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Kopa webhook URL ni verify token leswi kombisiwaka endzhaku ko hlayisa eka mavekelo ya webhook ya Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Nawu wa WhatsApp: u nga hlamula hi ku ntshunxeka ku ringana tiawara ta 24 endzhaku ka loko muxavi a ku rhumele rungula; ku sungula mburisano endzhaku ka sweswo swi lava template leyi pfumeleriweke hi Meta.

activities.a1: Pfula ntwanano kumbe muxavi u tsindzirisa Kunguhata, kumbe u tirhisa swiendlo swa xihatla (Qhingo, Imeyili, Nhlangano) ehenhla ka pheji ya vona.
activities.a2: A wu na ntirho lowu pfulekeke. Mintwanano leyi nga riki na goza leri landzelaka yi tala ku titimela, kutani kunguhata rin'we.
activities.p1: Tithebe ta leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi, namuntlha, leswi taka ni leswi hetisiweke
activities.p2: Cinca exikarhi ka mintirho ya wena ni ya un'wana ni un'wana
activities.p3: Nomboro yo tshwuka eka menyu yi hlayela leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi kumbe leswi faneleke namuntlha
activities.q2: Hikokwalaho ka yini ntwanano wu ri "A ku na goza leri landzelaka"?
activities.summary: Tiqhingo, minhlangano, mintirho ni masiku yo hetelela: magoza lama landzelaka eka mintwanano ni vaxavi hinkwavo.
activities.title: Mintirho

charts.p1: Phayiphi hi xiyimo: nkoka wa mintwanano leyi pfulekeke eka goza rin'wana ni rin'wana
charts.p2: Mali leyi hlengeletiweke: ti-hakelo leti amukeriweke n'hweti yin'wana ni yin'wana
charts.p3: Swikoloto: leswi ha saleke ni leswaku i swingani leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi
charts.summary: Tichati timbirhi leti kombaka laha mali ya wena yi humaka kona.
charts.title: Phayiphi ni mali

customers.a1: Ina. Mulawuri a nga engetela swivandla swo fana na Indasitiri eka Mavekelo > Swivandla swo engetela.
customers.p1: Vuhlanganisi, mintwanano, swiringanyeto ni tinhlayo-xikoloto eka muxavi un'wana ni un'wana
customers.p2: Xiyimo xa nkarhi xa imeyili yin'wana ni yin'wana, xitsundzuxo, qhingo ni hakelo
customers.p3: Leswi va ku kolotaka swona ni leswi va swi hakeleke
customers.q1: Xana ndzi nga engetela swivandla swa mina?
customers.summary: Mabindzu ni vanhu lava u va xavisaka, ni matimu ya vona hinkwawo endhawini yin'we.
customers.title: Vaxavi

dashboard.a1: Ti tala loko u engetela mintwanano ni ku tsala ti-hakelo. Mpimo wa ku hlula wu lava ntwanano wun'we lowu hluleriweke kumbe lowu lahlekeke.
dashboard.a2: Ina. Tsindzirisa nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana kumbe nhlokomhaka ya phanele ku pfula nxaxamelo lowu nga endzhaku ka yona.
dashboard.p1: Tinhlayo ta nkoka: phayiphi leyi pfulekeke, mintwanano leyi hluleriweke n'hweti leyi, mpimo wa ku hlula ni vukulu bya ntwanano lebyi tolovelekeke
dashboard.p2: Tichati: nkoka wa phayiphi hi xiyimo ni mali leyi hlengeletiweke eka tin'hweti ta tsevu
dashboard.p3: Siku ra wena: tiqhingo, minhlangano ni mintirho leyi faneleke namuntlha kumbe leyi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi
dashboard.p4: Mali leyi u kolotiwaka yona, mintwanano ya wena leyikulu leyi pfulekeke ni mintirho ya sweswinyana
dashboard.q1: Hikokwalaho ka yini tinhlayo tin'wana ti nga ri na nchumu?
dashboard.summary: Xikirini xa wena xa le kaya: ndlela leyi vuxavisi byi fambaka ha yona, leswi u faneleke ku swi endla namuntlha, ni leswi u kolotiwaka swona.
dashboard.title: Dexibodo

day.p1: Leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi ku sungula, hi muhlovo wo tshwuka
day.p2: Funghi nchumu ku wu funghi tanihi lowu hetisiweke
day.p3: Tsindzirisa vito ku pfula muxavi kumbe ntwanano
day.summary: Hinkwaswo leswi u kunguhateke ku swi endla namuntlha, swin'we ni leswi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi.
day.title: Siku ra wena

deals.a1: Wu koka u wu yisa eka Wu hluleriwile kumbe Wu lahlekile eka bodo, kumbe u tirhisa tikonopo eka pheji ya ntwanano. Mintwanano leyi lahlekeke yi vutisa xivangelo, leswi ku pfunaka ku dyondza.
deals.a2: Tsindzirisa Ntwanano lowuntshwa, hlawula muxavi u tata nkoka. Indasitiri yi tatiwa ku suka eka muxavi loko yi tiveka.
deals.p1: Ku languta bodo: koka ntwanano ku suka eka xiyimo ku ya eka xin'wana
deals.p2: Ku languta nxaxamelo: hlela u languta mintwanano hinkwayo
deals.p3: Ntwanano wun'wana ni wun'wana wu komba nkoka, n'wini, indasitiri ni goza leri landzelaka
deals.q1: Ndzi funghi njhani ntwanano tanihi lowu hluleriweke kumbe lowu lahlekeke?
deals.summary: Phayiphi ya wena ya vuxavisi: nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana ni xiyimo lexi wu nga eka xona.
deals.title: Layini ya vuxavisi

getStarted.a1: Vuxokoxoko bya khampani, imeyili, ntlawa ni WhatsApp/SMS swi lulamisiwa hi mulawuri eka Mavekelo.

getStarted.p2: Valawuri va nga fihla nxaxamelo loko va se lulamisile
getStarted.q1: Magoza man'wana ma ri "vutisa mulawuri wa wena".
getStarted.summary: Nxaxamelo lowu yisaka khampani leyintshwa ku suka eku tsariseni ku ya eka nhlayo-xikoloto ya yona yo sungula.
getStarted.title: Sungula

invoices.a1: Veka masiku eka Mavekelo > Hinkwaswo > Swotsundzuxo swa hakelo. Vaxavi va rhumeriwa imeyili hi xiviri nimixo wun'wana ni wun'wana; xotsundzuxo xin'wana ni xin'wana xi huma kan'we.
invoices.a2: Tidirafu ntsena. Nhlayo-xikoloto leyi rhumeriweke yi nga herisiwa, leswi yi hlayisaka eka rhekhodo.
invoices.p1: Swiyimo: dirafu, yi rhumeriwile, yi hakeriwe xiphemu, yi hakeriwile ni leyi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi
invoices.p2: Tsala ti-hakelo (EFT, karata, kheshe) loko ti nghena
invoices.p3: Swotsundzuxo swa hakelo swa xiviri emahlweni ni endzhaku ka siku ro hakela
invoices.summary: Hakerisa vaxavi u landzelela leswi hakeriweke.
invoices.title: Tinhlayo-xikoloto

language.summary: Tirhisa app hi ririmi rin'wana ni rin'wana eka tindzimi ta 11 ta ximfumo ta Afrika-Dzonga. Munhu un'wana ni un'wana u tihlawulela ra yena.
language.title: Ririmi

marketing.a1: Vaxavi lava tirhaka lava nga ni adirese ya imeyili lava nga tihumesangiki. Imeyili yin'wana ni yin'wana yi ni xihlanganisi xo tihumesa, hilaha POPIA yi lavaka hakona.

marketing.p2: Vayingiseri: mintlawa yo fana na "va xave eka masiku ya 90 yo hetelela"
marketing.p3: Mbuyelo: i mani a pfuleke ni loyi a tihumeseke
marketing.summary: Rhumela vaxavi va wena imeyili hi swiendliwa leswintshwa ni swo hlawuleka.
marketing.title: Vuxavisi bya ku tivisa

messages.a2: Mulawuri wa wena u fanele ku ti hlanganisa ku sungula eka Mavekelo > WhatsApp ni SMS.
messages.p1: Thebe ya vaxavi: mbulavurisano wun'wana ni wun'wana, lowuntshwa ku sungula, leyi nga hlayiwangiki yi funghiwile
messages.p2: Hlamula, kumbe u engetela xitsundzuxo xa le ndzeni lexi voniwaka hi ntlawa wa wena ntsena
messages.p3: Nyika munhu mbulavurisano u wu pfala loko wu hetile
messages.p4: Thebe ya ntlawa: tichanele ta mbulavurisano ta vatirhi va wena
messages.q1: Tinhlamulo ta vaxavi ti fika njhani laha?
messages.q2: Hikokwalaho ka yini ndzi nga swi koti ku hlawula WhatsApp kumbe SMS?
messages.summary: Bokisi rin'we ra imeyili, WhatsApp ni SMS na vaxavi, swin'we ni mbulavurisano na ntlawa wa wena.
messages.title: Marungula

products.a1: Pfula xiendliwa u engetela ntsengo wo hlawuleka ni siku ro hela. Xi komba baji ya Xo hlawuleka ku fikela siku ri hundza.

products.p2: Swo hlawuleka leswi nga ni siku ro hela, leswi kombisiwaka eka ti-imeyili ta vuxavisi
